diffuseAlbedo.source: Substances/opal-glass.json: optics.luminousTransmittance (0.32 ± 0.08), optics.spectralTransmittance and optics.specularF0 (0.0432), all from the SCHOTT OPALIKA data sheet as recorded there; this shading record's sheet.transmittance [0.335, 0.31, 0.27]
diffuseAlbedo.note: Accepted only as an UPPER BOUND. The inequality holds because every term left out (absorption, the second face's specular reflection) is non-negative. The SCHOTT PDF could not be read here, so the inputs rest on the research record. Two cautions. (1) Per the proposal's own frit analogy (Wilson and Elstner 2018: T 0.32, R 0.57-0.62, so about 0.06-0.1 absorbed), the true value is probably 0.55-0.65, below this bound, especially in blue. (2) This record's sheet.transmittance [0.335, 0.31, 0.27] claims to be read near 650/550/450 nm, but the research record's spectrum there is [0.33, 0.32, 0.30]. Recomputed from the spectrum, the bound is [0.627, 0.637, 0.657]. The blue channel should be rechecked before the bound is used as the value.
diffuseAlbedo.derivation: Energy balance per channel with absorption neglected: R_diffuse <= 1 - F0 - T = 1 - 0.043 - [0.335, 0.31, 0.27] = [0.622, 0.647, 0.687]
